explanation: The bare skin under the tail tip has ridges much like fingerprints. A spider monkey can hang by its tail alone, leaving its long arms free to reach fruit.

claims.text: Spider monkeys have prehensile tails with a bare, ridged gripping pad near the tip.
Squirrel monkeys, golden lion tamarins and common marmosets do not have prehensile tails.
The bare skin on a spider monkey's tail tip has ridges like fingerprints.
Spider monkeys can hang by their tails alone while feeding.
